object_description: compact five-story building volume with a recessed terrace and stacked floors
design_condition: Placed at the northern corner as a hinge between the school and neighborhood, the vertically dense building preserves most of the meadow and trees while extending the site's path network.

positive.statement: The compact building volume acts as a hinge between the school area and the surrounding neighborhood.

position.rationale: Compact footprint and tall stacked elevations clearly identify the central hinge volume.

positive.statement: The diagonal connection through the school area creates an urban connection to the buildings on Welschmattstrasse.

position.rationale: The diagonal connection is approximated along the building’s angled plan perimeter.

positive.statement: The spatially vertical densification preserves a large, contiguous and attractive area of parking space and trees.

position.rationale: Unbuilt site area is placed beside the compact mass toward the eastern side.

positive.statement: The project cleverly continues the fine network of paths and supplements it with a new path axis.

position.target: fine path network and new path axis
position.rationale: Paths are not individually visible; marker follows the building’s lower-left approach zone.

positive.statement: The compact form makes the project fundamentally economical.

position.rationale: Dense rectangular plan and five vertically stacked levels visibly support compactness.

positive.statement: The compact volume has the lowest building envelope number.

position.rationale: The compact envelope is directly represented by the concentrated point-cloud mass.

positive.statement: The location of the foyer and auditorium on the third floor is a strong idea.

position.target: foyer and auditorium on third floor
position.rationale: Third-floor program is not distinguishable; marker is constrained to the middle stacked level.

negative.statement: The five-story building appears alien and incongruous with the existing complex.

position.rationale: Tall, dense stacked mass is clearly visible and provides the scale reference.

negative.statement: The project makes little statement about new outdoor uses.

position.rationale: Outdoor programming is not identifiable; marker occupies the adjacent eastern open area.

negative.statement: The catering kitchen would have to be optimized, enlarged and moved to the day structures.

position.rationale: Kitchen is internal and unmarked; approximate location is assigned to a lower side of the volume.

negative.statement: The music rooms are too small and have an unfavorable spatial geometry for music lessons.

position.rationale: Room geometry is absent; marker uses an upper lateral surface region.

negative.statement: The arrangement of the room program is not very convincing from the user's perspective.

position.rationale: Program arrangement is internal, so it is approximated within the stacked building envelope.

negative.statement: The complex development situation results in a lot of traffic space, and the daily structure is difficult to organize.

position.rationale: Circulation is not modeled distinctly; marker uses the adjacent eastern ground zone.

negative.statement: Public access to the auditorium over three floors raises operational questions.

position.rationale: Access route is not visible; marker follows the lower central facade and stacked access zone.

negative.statement: The escape route situation with only one escape staircase does not work and is unresolved.

position.rationale: Stair location is not distinguishable; approximate marker is placed on the east side.
